inputs.context: Caller-owned snapshot from actual current record/catalog/proof AFTER native validates full-source factual/primary-unit/effect/P/S/owner/dependency/guard/profile invariants. It is actual data, not a source_qualified flag supplied in candidate JSON.
context_fields: positive_fields keyed by (RID,pointer), actual full text; only native-positive primary pointers
closure_snapshot containing complete owner_maps/effect_sets/guard_sets/dependencies/profile_contracts/reference_sha256 and all fact requires edges
authoritative_contract_sha256 computed from exact current source/proof snapshot by the native caller

checks: exact fields/types/caps/unique view IDs/unique ref positions

each fact listed by ordinary semantic unit sameRID and exact ownpointer; unit quote equals current full primary field; canonical fact quote and facet substring contained in that SAME current full field
semantic_reference/nonsemantic/tag/guard-only fields cannot supply normal positive canonical anchors
fact modes are unchanged; context cannot support direct spec, no P/S sentinel-as-missing-trait promotion
all original target/receiver positions accounted for without target override, fixed actual entity IDs or invented endpoints
requires closure exact sameRID original P/S refs; whole closure fingerprint includes every actual owner/guard/dependency/profile obligation without executing them
no canonical fact/role/effect/coverage produced by the helper; role scope/RID coverage checked by native integration using actual validated support
api.output: Nonserializable-in-intent immutable normalized structural binding result, copied tuples/maps (no mutable alias to inputs), keyed (role_id,RID,fact_id). Exposes source_contract_sha256 and views_sha256 plus actual original fact refs. Never returns qualified/eligible/source_reviewed=True or permission. Structural token is not an authentication/security capability; callers must not trust a reconstructed instance.
api.failure: ValueError on malformed/stale/unbound declarations. A well-shaped false NL facet can still pass; reviewer/root must reject semantic falsehood.

api.name: compact_views(validated, *, authoritative_contract_sha256) -> JSON receipt
api.inputs: Only output of validate_full_views in the same native full-validation→compact operation; external full source-contract digest must match. Caller never accepts a candidate-authored standalone receipt.
api.output: Bound CID/RID/role/specSHA/fact IDs/full fact digest/field+unit+facet digests/endpoint positions/requires refs/whole closure digest/view digest/full qualification digest. Large quote/rationale may be omitted only after binding in full proof. Full/native/compact fingerprints include all receipts.
api.failure: No API path to promote arbitrary compact-only supplied views or selfhash into full-source validation. Receipt selfhash detects changes only against an independently expected exact authority digest; it cannot establish manual truth or provenance.

api.name: selected_support(validated_or_verified_receipt, *, expected_binding, role_id, realization_id, fact_id) -> bool or binding
api.inputs: Native caller supplies expected binding from currently qualified full source or already source-validated immutable published corpus/runtime. For compact receipt verify exact match with that external authority plus current source/catalog/selected-effect/closure invariants.
api.output: Only existence of an exact reviewed structural support binding. Native qualification reports original actual matched_properties/modes/factrefs and can annotate support_kind=manual_semantic_role_view; no synthetic projected property or mutation dimension.
api.failure: Unavailable authoritative expected binding returns review_required at native integration; no fallback accepting recomputed receipt ownhash. Foreign RID/spec/source/closure/selected fact rejects.
